so i just used this suggestion and added temporary package which will solve our issues after upgrades and later on whenever exact package release officially then we just need to update it.

issues.title: Avoid deprecated library
issues.body:
When the app runs in the dev mode (:3000), we get this warning:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/122639994-dd665180-d0f4-11eb-8222-04c9bc51e799.png)

Here's the link: https://developer.chrome.com/blog/enabling-shared-array-buffer/

I don't really understand it, but am concerned something may break next month.

We should investigate the issue, and see if it's in our code (and we fix it), or an upstream dependancy (so we update dependency).
